title: ‘The Gentlemen’ Star Theo James Is Ready to Talk About That Bloody Season 2 Ending
summary: The star and co-executive producer talks with The Hollywood Reporter about his and Guy Ritchie's deeper and darker second season, how that finale sets up season three — and the rumored casting of the real-life Duchess of Sussex: "It's fascinating how [those reports] exploded that much, and how intrigued people are.
